facts.statement: Free Realms published a preview of its newest television commercial, titled 'Temps de Faire la Fête!' (Time to Party!), on its site's What is New section.
facts.quote: Voici un aperçu de notre plus récent publicité à la télévision: Temps de Faire la Fête!

article_summaries.title: Un Aperçu-Temps de Faire la Fête! (A Preview - Time to Party!)
article_summaries.summary: A short French-language freerealms.com 'What is New?' post offering a preview of a new Free Realms TV commercial titled 'Temps de Faire la Fête!' (Time to Party!). The page gives no date beyond a relative 'Posted 1 year, 2 months ago' and no gameplay details, so it is of little use for mechanics, quests or items.
